class_name: 限定-選択肢なし-イガイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: As a formal noun it takes a noun through の (この店のほか) and a plain dictionary-form verb directly (そうするほかない); its sibling 以外 clamps straight onto the bare noun instead. The particle after it sets the direction: のほかに／のほかも adds a second item, のほかは with a negative predicate sets everything else aside (この道のほかは知らない), and のほかに with a negative narrows things down to one (彼のほかにいない). ほか leans additive ("besides", comfortable with も) and is written in kana rather than 他 in 公用文 and most publishing style; 以外 is the Sino-formal, explicitly exclusionary member ("except for").

examples.ruby: この店[みせ]では和菓子[わがし]のほかに洋菓子[ようがし]も売[う]っている。
examples.english: Besides Japanese sweets, this shop also sells Western-style pastries.

examples.ruby: 彼[かれ]のほかに、この機械[きかい]を直[なお]せる人[ひと]はいない。
examples.english: Apart from him, there's nobody who can fix this machine.

examples.ruby: ご連絡[れんらく]はメールのほか、お電話[でんわ]でも承[うけたまわ]ります。
examples.english: You can reach us by phone as well as by email.

patterns.usage_note: Normally written 以外. It attaches directly to a bare noun with no の, and also to a plain dictionary-form verb (謝る以外に方法がない), so it is the workhorse for drawing an exclusion line around a whole action. Both ほか and 以外 take verbs; what separates them is register and force: 以外 is the Sino-formal, explicitly exclusionary member, and it is the default in set-phrase exclusions like それ以外. With a following negative it hardens into "nothing but"; with は or に it simply sets everything else aside.

examples.ruby: 日曜日[にちようび]以外[いがい]は、朝[あさ]六時[ろくじ]に起[お]きています。
examples.english: Except on Sundays, I'm up at six in the morning.

examples.ruby: もう一度[いちど]謝[あやま]る以外[いがい]に、方法[ほうほう]はないだろう。
examples.english: There's probably nothing for it but to apologize one more time.

examples.ruby: 会議[かいぎ]の資料[しりょう]以外[いがい]は、机[つくえ]の上[うえ]に置[お]かないでください。
examples.english: Please don't leave anything on the desk except the meeting materials.
